description: AICTIONBOT™ Painpoint Atlas by KULIC Advisory (Dario Kulic, 20+ years in procurement and Source-to-Pay). Returns the map: 12 fields such as invoice and payment, approvals, demand and intake, contracts, each with the titles of its pain points, 49 in total, built on 458 documented findings. 12 pain points with 99 findings are open and can be read with get_painpoint; the other titles are listed so a situation can be named, their content is part of the full Atlas. Use it to find the field a problem belongs to. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source.
